description: This file defines the Log class in the Goteo application's Model namespace. It provides functionality for retrieving and appending log entries, including methods for validation and saving to the database.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A class representing application logs, with methods to retrieve and create log entries, as well as validate and save them.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a log entry by its ID from the database.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Creates and appends a new log entry, automatically associating it with the current user if logged in.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the log entry data, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the log entry to the database after validation.
